messages:
Alex: Heads up — planning to cut release/v1.16.0 tomorrow (2026-03-18) at 16:00 PT. Need clear owners for: tagging, changelog entry, backports triage, and a quick canary smoke. Who can take which?

Maria: I can take changelog. Will open the CHANGELOG PR and link to the release checklist.

Devon: I can do tagging + push the annotated tag after CI passes. Plan: `git tag -a v1.16.0 -m \"release v1.16.0\"` then `git push origin v1.16.0`. I'll wait for the final green. :+1:

Lucy: I can own backport triage for critical fixes. Please add the label `backport-needed` to any PRs that should be cherry-picked. I'll assemble a backport PR list.

Riya: I'll create the release checklist issue template and add the `release/v1.16.0` column on the release board. Also will add a small note about special backport rules for config-schema changes.

Alex: Awesome — assigning: Maria (changelog), Devon (tagging), Lucy (backports), Riya (release board + checklist). Can someone take a canary smoke on dedicated for a quick perf and auth sanity check?

Sneha: I can run the canary smoke at 15:30 PT (30m before cut) — will test 10 representative endpoints and sanity-check latencies. I will paste a quick result summary here.

Alex: Perfect. A couple of small procedural notes:
- Please ensure all backport PRs include `cherry-pick` labels and reference the original PR number.
- Use this branch naming when creating the release branch: `git checkout -b release/v1.16.0 origin/main` then `git push -u origin release/v1.16.0`.
- For hotfix-only backports, prefer `release/1.16-hotfix` branch targeting the release branch if needed.

Devon: On tagging: I'll only push the tag once the main branch CI and the release branch smoke are green. If we need rollback, we'll use the fallback tag `v1.16.0-rollback` and the rollback playbook.

Lucy: For backport policy reminder:
1) Security and data-loss fixes -> mandatory backport.
2) Non-silent API changes -> discuss on PR before backport.
3) Docs/typo -> usually skip unless customer-facing docs.

Maria: CHANGELOG PR will include summaries and link to PRs. Planning to squash small fixes into grouped bullets. Will add a QA signoff checklist at the bottom.

Riya: I also added a label `release-blocker` for any PR that must land before cut. If you add it, ping me directly so I can escalate.

release-bot: Reminder queued: release/v1.16.0 cut scheduled 2026-03-18 16:00 PT. Automations will: create branch, run release CI, and notify this channel when branch exists.

Alex: Two last asks: (1) If you expect any backports, comment them on the release checklist before EOD today. (2) If you are the tag owner, please post the tag SHA here after pushing.

Devon: Will do. I'll post `git rev-parse v1.16.0` output after push.

Sneha: Canary smoke scheduled — I'll post results ~15:50 PT.

Lucy: I'll start triaging PRs now and add `backport-needed` where appropriate. Expect an initial list in ~45m. :mag_right:

Maria: CHANGELOG PR draft opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4387 — feedback welcome.

Alex: Thanks all — feel free to @-ping if anything blocks your assigned area.

Devon: quick note: tagging command to run after branch exists and CI green:
```
# create annotated tag
git tag -a v1.16.0 -m \"release v1.16.0\"
# push tag
git push origin v1.16.0
```

Maria: I'll merge changelog after Lucy confirms backport list, to avoid missing entries.

Lucy: Backport list posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/projects/12#card-9876 — will open cherry-picks as we go.

Alex: Great. Closing loop — see you in the cut channel during the window. :rocket:
